label: v_note full rows
sql: SELECT slug,title,type,status,description,created,modified,access_count,inbound,outbound,pagerank,betweenness,q_value,q_updates,exposure_count FROM v_note ORDER BY slug

label: v_note null pagerank count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(pagerank IS NULL) AS null_pr, SUM(betweenness IS NULL) AS null_bt, ROUND(SUM(pagerank),6) AS pr_sum FROM v_note

label: v_link all edges
sql: SELECT src,src_title,dst,dst_title FROM v_link ORDER BY src,dst

label: v_link contains dangling target?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_link WHERE dst LIKE '%nonexist%' OR dst_title LIKE '%nonexist%' OR dst IS NULL OR dst_title IS NULL

label: inbound vs v_link crosscheck
sql: SELECT n.slug, n.inbound, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_link l WHERE l.dst=n.slug) AS link_in, n.outbound, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_link l WHERE l.src=n.slug) AS link_out FROM v_note n ORDER BY n.slug

label: join v_note x v_link
sql: SELECT a.slug, a.pagerank, l.dst FROM v_note a JOIN v_link l ON l.src=a.slug ORDER BY a.slug, l.dst

label: natural join v_retrieval x v_session
sql: SELECT * FROM v_retrieval NATURAL JOIN v_session

label: natural join v_retrieval x v_note
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_retrieval NATURAL JOIN v_note

label: natural join v_stage x v_session
sql: SELECT * FROM v_stage NATURAL JOIN v_session
